    Modeling-level distance constraint on a sequence variable (SeqVar), maintaining the total travel distance between consecutive visited nodes in the sequence.

    Precedence constraint on a sequence variable (SeqVar), ensuring that the given nodes appear in the specified relative order if visited in the sequence.
    final record 
    Require
    Require a node to be visited within a SeqVar

    Constraint ensuring that the sequence sub is a subsequence of main (all nodes visited in sub are visited in main in the same relative order).
